title: Karyopharm Submits Supplemental New Drug Application to the FDA for XPOVIO® (selinexor) Plus Ruxolitinib for Patients with Myelofibrosis
summary: Karyopharm Therapeutics Inc. (Nasdaq: KPTI), a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company pioneering novel cancer therapies, today announced that it has submitted a supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) seeking Accelerated Approval for XPOVIO® (selinexor) in combination with ruxolitinib for patients with myelofibrosis. Karyopharm requested Priority Review of the application, which, if granted, could result in a six-month review process.
